# SellerMath

> Free, accurate 2026 fee and profit calculators for online marketplace sellers. All calculators run entirely in the browser, need no account, and collect no data.

Sitemap: https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/sitemap.xml

## Tools

- [Etsy Fee Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/): Etsy fees for 2026 — $0.20 listing fee, 6.5% transaction fee, country-specific payment processing, regulatory operating fee and optional Offsite Ads (15% under $10k, 12% over $10k). Shows net profit, margin, break-even price and the exact item price for a target margin. Updated for Etsy's June 22, 2026 fee changes.
- [Amazon FBA Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/amazon-fba-calculator.html): Amazon FBA fees for 2026 — referral fee by category (8–15%), FBA fulfillment fee by size tier and weight, storage and inbound costs, with net profit, ROI, margin, break-even price and monthly profit. Includes non-peak and Oct 15–Jan 14 peak rates.
- [eBay Fee Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/ebay-calculator.html): eBay final value fees for 2026 by category (most categories 13.6%, with caps and Store discounts), per-order fee, net profit, margin and break-even price.
- [Shopify Profit Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/shopify-calculator.html): Shopify 2026 plans (Basic $27, Grow $65, Advanced $399) and Shopify Payments card rates (2.9/2.7/2.5% + $0.30), third-party gateway fees, per-order and monthly profit, break-even price.
- [Dropshipping Profit Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/dropshipping-profit-calculator.html): net profit per order after supplier cost, supplier shipping, payment fee (Stripe/PayPal), ad CPA, returns reserve, other costs and per-order plan share; net margin, break-even CAC (max ad cost), actual vs required ROAS and monthly break-even orders.
- [AI Pricing Copilot](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/pricing-copilot.html): guided chat that takes category, landed cost, weight and target net margin and reverse-solves the exact price to charge on Amazon FBA, Walmart WFS, eBay, Etsy and Shopify, listing each fee, net profit, margin and a "sell here first" recommendation based on category fit and whether the platform supplies its own traffic.
- [TikTok Shop Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/tiktok-calculator.html): TikTok Shop US referral fee for 2026 — 6% for most categories (specific jewelry and pre-owned categories 5%), no fixed per-order fee, payment processing included; optional creator affiliate commission. Net profit, margin and break-even.
- [PayPal Fee Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/paypal-calculator.html): US PayPal 2026 fees — Checkout 3.49% + $0.49, Goods & Services 2.99%, international +1.5%, QR 2.29%, Pay Later 4.99%, micropayments ~5% + $0.05 — with payout and reverse invoice.
- [Stripe Fee Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/stripe-calculator.html): US Stripe 2026 — 2.9% + $0.30 domestic, international +1.5%, currency conversion +1%, manual entry +0.5% — with payout and reverse amount.
- [Profit Margin Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/profit-margin-calculator.html): Gross profit, profit margin (profit ÷ price) vs markup (profit ÷ cost), and the selling price for a target margin. Platform-independent.
- [ROAS Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/roas-calculator.html): Return on ad spend, gross profit, net after ads, and break-even ROAS (1 ÷ gross margin), with a profitable/losing verdict.
- [Break-Even Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/break-even-calculator.html): Units and revenue needed to break even (fixed costs ÷ contribution margin) and to reach a target profit.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/sales-tax-calculator.html): US state-level sales tax rates for 2026 (state rate pre-selected, optional local add-on), tax amount, tax-inclusive total, and a reverse calculation from a tax-inclusive price.
- [Amazon ACoS Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/acos-calculator.html): Advertising cost of sale (spend ÷ attributed sales), TACoS, break-even ACoS from net margin, and the ROAS equivalent.
- [Etsy UK Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/etsy-fee-calculator-uk.html): Etsy fees in pounds (£) with UK payment rates.
- [Etsy Australia Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/etsy-fee-calculator-australia.html): Etsy fees in Australian dollars (A$).
- [Etsy Canada Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/etsy-fee-calculator-canada.html): Etsy fees in Canadian dollars (C$).
- [Embed Widget](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/embed.html): Free embeddable Etsy fee calculator for blogs and seller sites.
- [Etsy vs eBay Fees](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/etsy-vs-ebay-fees.html): Side-by-side — Etsy $0.20 listing + 6.5% transaction + 3% + $0.25 payment vs eBay 13.6% final value + $0.40 per order (payment included). For typical items above ~$15–20 Etsy's all-in fee is usually lower.
- [PayPal vs Stripe Fees](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/paypal-vs-stripe-fees.html): PayPal Checkout 3.49% + $0.49 vs Stripe 2.9% + $0.30; both +1.5% international, Stripe +1% FX and +0.5% manual entry. For standard US online sales Stripe is usually slightly cheaper.
- [Etsy vs Shopify Costs](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/etsy-vs-shopify-fees.html): Etsy no subscription but ~9.5% all-in per sale vs Shopify $27/$65/$399 plan with 2.9/2.7/2.5% + $0.30 card fees. Shopify becomes cheaper per sale once order volume covers the subscription; Etsy supplies the audience, Shopify requires self-driven traffic.
- [Mercari Fee Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/mercari-fee-calculator.html): US Mercari 2026 — flat 10% selling fee on item price plus buyer-paid shipping; no listing fee and no seller payment processing since January 6, 2025. The buyer's separate 3.6% Buyer Protection fee does not reduce the payout.
- [Poshmark Fee Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/poshmark-fee-calculator.html): US Poshmark 2026 — flat $2.95 on sales under $15, 20% commission on $15 and up, calculated on item price only; the buyer pays flat-rate shipping, no listing or monthly fees.
- [Mercari vs Poshmark Fees](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/mercari-vs-poshmark-fees.html): Mercari 10% (on price + buyer shipping) vs Poshmark $2.95 / 20% (item price only). On fees Mercari is usually cheaper for $15+ orders, while Poshmark's larger fashion-focused audience can mean faster sales or higher prices.
- [Depop Fee Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/depop-fee-calculator.html): US & UK 2026 — 0% selling fee (removed in 2024); only payment processing, US 3.3% + $0.45 / UK 2.9% + £0.30 on item + shipping + tax; optional Boost is 12% of item price, charged only when a boosted listing sells (28-day window). Sellers outside US/UK still pay 10%.
- [eBay vs Amazon Fees](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/ebay-vs-amazon-fees.html): eBay ~13.6%+$0.30 vs Amazon 8–15% referral. For most categories at $25–$200, eBay is cheaper; Amazon's lower-rate categories (electronics 8%) can flip it. FBA fulfillment adds $3–$7+/unit.
- [eBay vs Etsy Fees](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/ebay-vs-etsy-fees.html): eBay ~14% all-in vs Etsy ~10–11%. Etsy is usually cheaper by 3–4 points on most sales. eBay's low-rate categories (electronics 9%, sneakers 8%) can be cheaper than Etsy.
- [Etsy vs Amazon Handmade Fees](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/etsy-vs-amazon-handmade.html): Etsy ~10–11% all-in vs Amazon Handmade flat 15%. Etsy is cheaper per sale; Amazon Handmade offers Prime/FBA access and waived monthly fee for approved artisans.
- [Resale Profit Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/resale-profit-calculator.html): Calculate exact net profit, margin, and ROI on every thrift flip. Supports eBay (13.25%), Poshmark (20%), Mercari (10%), Depop (~3.3%+processing), Etsy, and local sales with 0% fees.
- [Sales Tax by State](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/sales-tax-by-state.html): Hub linking to all 51 state sales tax calculators (50 states + DC) with 2026 state + average local combined rates and economic nexus thresholds (source: Tax Foundation mid-2026). Each state page does add-tax and reverse (gross-to-net) calculations, e.g. california-sales-tax-calculator.html, texas-sales-tax-calculator.html.
- [COGS Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/cogs-calculator.html): Cost of goods sold (beginning inventory + purchases − ending inventory) and per-unit landed cost (wholesale + freight + packaging + duties + inspection + defects).
- [Markup vs Margin Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/markup-vs-margin-calculator.html): Convert markup ↔ margin and derive selling price from cost; price = cost×(1+markup) = cost÷(1−margin).
- [Amazon FBA vs FBM Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/fba-vs-fbm-calculator.html): 2026 referral + FBA fulfillment vs self-fulfilled shipping/materials, with per-unit profit and the break-even price where FBM overtakes FBA.
- [LTV:CAC Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/ltv-cac-calculator.html): Customer lifetime value, LTV:CAC ratio and CAC payback months from AOV, margin, purchase frequency and customer lifespan.
- [E-commerce Conversion Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/ecommerce-conversion-calculator.html): Conversion rate, add-to-cart rate, cart abandonment, AOV and revenue per visitor from sessions, orders and revenue.
- [Grailed Fee Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/grailed-fee-calculator.html): Grailed 2026 — 6% commission under $120 (min $1.99), 9% at $120+, plus domestic 3.49%+$0.49 / international 4.99%+$0.49 payment.
- [Reorder Point Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/reorder-point-calculator.html): Safety stock (Z×σ×√lead time) and reorder point (daily demand×lead time + safety stock), with days-until-stockout and order quantity.
- [Shipping Cost Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/shipping-cost-calculator.html): USPS vs UPS vs FedEx estimated cost from weight, zone (1–8), packaging and fuel surcharge; estimates only, carrier rates prevail.
- [Pricing Strategy Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/pricing-strategy-calculator.html): Cost-plus, target-margin, competitor-based and charm (.99) pricing in one tool.
- [Return Cost Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/return-cost-calculator.html): Full return cost (refund + processing + COGS not recovered − resale value), net margin after returns and break-even return rate, with 2026 category return-rate benchmarks.
- [Sell-Through Rate Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/sell-through-calculator.html): Sell-through rate, annual inventory turnover, days inventory outstanding and carrying cost of unsold stock.
- [UK VAT Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/uk-vat-calculator.html): Add/remove VAT at 20%, 5% and 0%; at 20% VAT is 1/6 of gross, so divide gross by 1.2 rather than multiplying by 0.8.
- [Poshmark vs Depop Fees](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/poshmark-vs-depop-fees.html): Poshmark $2.95/20% vs Depop 0% commission, payment only (US 3.3%+$0.45 / UK 2.9%+£0.30); US/UK toggle.
- [Whatnot vs eBay Fees](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/whatnot-vs-ebay-fees.html): Whatnot 8% (electronics 5%, coins 4%) + 2.9%+$0.30 with 0% commission above $1,500 vs eBay ~13.25%+$0.30.
- [StockX vs GOAT Fees](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/stockx-vs-goat-fees.html): Sneaker/streetwear resale — StockX 7–9% by seller level + 3% payment + $5 minimum vs GOAT 9.5–25% by seller rating + $5 fee + 2.9% cashout (free to GOAT credit); near-identical for new sellers.
- [Walmart Marketplace Fee Calculator](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/walmart-fee-calculator.html): 2026 referral fee by category (5–15%, price/tier based) with WFS fulfillment ($3.45 ≤1 lb up to big & bulky), storage, and net profit, margin, ROI and break-even. No setup, monthly or hidden fees; new sellers can get 20% off referral fees on the first $50K GMV.

## Key fee facts (2026)

- Etsy: $0.20 listing fee; 6.5% transaction fee; US payment processing 3% + $0.25; Offsite Ads 15% (12% over $10k in 12 months).
- Amazon: referral 8–15% by category; FBA fulfillment charged by size/weight (about $4.22 for a 1 lb standard item); peak surcharge Oct 15–Jan 14.
- eBay: 13.6% final value fee for most categories (2026), plus a per-order fee; caps apply in some categories.
- Shopify: Basic $27/mo; card rate 2.9% + $0.30; third-party gateways add 2%.
- TikTok Shop US: 6% referral for most categories; no separate payment fee.
- PayPal US: Checkout 3.49% + $0.49; international +1.5%.
- Stripe US: 2.9% + $0.30; international +1.5%; FX +1%.
- Mercari US: flat 10% of item price + buyer-paid shipping; no seller payment fee (since Jan 6, 2025); buyer pays 3.6% protection fee.
- Poshmark US: $2.95 flat under $15; 20% on $15+, item price only; buyer pays shipping.
